name: GIL
description: GIL (Geometric Information Learner) is a published Python ML package that applies information geometry principles to tabular learning. Implements Riemannian manifold-aware gradient descent, Fisher information matrix regularization, and Information Bottleneck imputation for missing data. Offers a scikit-learn compatible API for drop-in integration. Includes comprehensive test suite, CI/CD pipeline via GitHub Actions, and pre-commit hooks. Addresses fundamental geometric structure of data distributions that standard Euclidean-space models ignore.
